records.name: ZZ_TEST_PT_TOOLONG
problems: Name is longer than 15 characters (Oracle's limit for Receivables payment terms). Shorten it.

records.name: ZZ_TEST_PT_SUM
problems: The installments add up to 90, but Base Amount is 100. They must add up to exactly 100.

records.name: ZZ_TEST_PT_SET
problems: Set Code 'ZZ_TEST_NO_SET' isn't one of Oracle's reference data sets.

records.name: ZZ_TEST_AG_CHAR
problems: Class row 1: no grouping rule in Oracle uses characteristic 'L.INTERFACE_LINE_ATTRIBUTE15', so it can't be confirmed before Create (Oracle has no list of them to read).

records.name: ZZ_TEST_AG_DATES
problems: To Date (15 October 2026) must be after From Date (1 November 2026).

records.name: ZZ_TEST_TT_TOO_LONG_X
problems: Name 'ZZ_TEST_TT_TOO_LONG_X' has 21 characters; Oracle takes at most 20. It is never shortened for you.

records.name: ZZ_TEST_TT_CM
problems: Class 'Credit Memo' isn't offered yet: this version offers Invoice and Debit Memo only (a credit memo needs a negative sign, and the other classes need setup that isn't on the sheet).

records.name: ZZ_TEST_TT_BOTH
problems: Natural Application Only and Allow Overapplication can't both be Yes.

records.name: ZZ_TEST_TT_TERM
problems: Payment Term 'ZZ_TEST_NO_TERM' in set COMMON isn't in Oracle and isn't on this sheet's Receivables Payment Terms tab.

records.name: ZZ_TEST_TS_ZERO
problems: Last Number must be a whole number, 1 or more; it says '0'.

records.name: ZZ_TEST_TS_MANUAL
problems: A grouping rule only applies to an AutoInvoice source; this one is Manual.

records.name: ZZ_TEST_TS_NORULE
problems: Grouping Rule 'ZZ_TEST_NO_RULE' isn't in Oracle and isn't on this sheet's AutoInvoice Grouping Rules tab.

records.name: ZZ_TEST_TS_NUMBER
problems: Last Number only applies with automatic numbering.
